title: Todos
steps: Open Chores. Due dates are coloured: overdue in orange, today in blue, later in grey.
Put the cursor on a todo and press ⌘Enter (Ctrl+Enter off a Mac) to check it off. Do it on Water the plants: it repeats every 3 days, so a new one appears above, due 3 days after the old date.
⌘⇧P, Show todos: every open todo in every note, under Overdue, Today, Upcoming and No date. Click one to jump to its line.
Write your own: `- [ ] Call the bank due:2026-12-01 every:month`. `every:` takes day, weekday, week, month or year, with an optional count, like `every:2weeks`.
